description: This file defines the AWS FISClient class which is a client for interacting with the AWS Fault Injection Simulator service. It provides method annotations for various API calls related to experiment templates, target accounts, experiments, resource types, and safety lever controls.

classes.name: FISClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS Fault Injection Simulator, extending the base AwsClient class, with methods for managing experiments, configurations, and resources.

methods.name: createExperimentTemplate
methods.description: Creates a new experiment template in AWS Fault Injection Simulator.

methods.name: createExperimentTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new experiment template.

methods.name: getExperiment
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific experiment.

methods.name: getExperimentAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific experiment.

methods.name: updateExperimentTemplateAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing experiment template.
